content.question: What is the difference between clustering and association in unsupervised learning?
options: Clustering groups data points based on their similarity and natural patterns, while association discovers relationships between different data points or their features.
Clustering uses labeled data, while association uses unlabeled data.
Clustering predicts continuous values, while association predicts discrete categories.
Clustering learns from rewards and penalties, while association learns from labels.
content.answer: Clustering groups data points based on their similarity and natural patterns, while association discovers relationships between different data points or their features.
